Figure 17 and Figure 18, depict the activities displayed after completing a 
question or lesson respectively. The primary function of the pages is to show the 
students’ their performance aiming to bolster motivation and engagement. 
Additionally, Figure 17 provides the answer to the prior question, helping aid and 
correct the students understanding. Animations are used to further improve the 
style of these pages, the use of confetti falling down by (Lottifiles, n.d.) will be 
used on Figure 18, while the tick or cross on Figure 17 will uses these 
animations (LottieFiles, n.d.; LottieFiles, n.d.).
